headline: Air Source vs. Ground Source (Geothermal) Heat Pumps
subheading: Ground source heat pumps are more efficient and last longer. Air source heat pumps are far cheaper to install and fit almost any home. Here's how they compare on efficiency, cost, lifespan and space.
seoTitle: Air Source vs. Ground Source (Geothermal) Heat Pumps
description: Air source vs. ground source (geothermal) heat pumps: how they compare on efficiency, installation cost, lifespan and space, and which makes sense for your home.
